 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing and constructing residential houses under the name of “ ZAMEEN ACE HOMES ”, located at Phase III, Sector A and Sector B, Defence Housing Authority Islamabad - Rawalpindi ( “ Venture ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the location and Floor P lan of the finished house and the Buyer is desirous to purchase , as described in the Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”); and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer will construct and sell the rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit , all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions; 
 Appendix A: Payment Plan; 
 Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan; 
 Appendix C: List of Material s ; and 
 Any other document incorporated by reference in this Agreement . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 SCHEDULE B 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority , including DHAI-R and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Venture or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated Completion Date 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause s 3 (Payment) and 5 (Construction and Possession of Purchased Unit ) of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the P urchased Unit. 
 
 Developer means V4 Capital with its office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore. 
 
 DHAI-R means Defence Housing Authority Islamabad-Rawalpindi. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing. 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 1 4 .1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Furnishings means the furniture items listed in Table C of A ppendix C . 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause 3.3, include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 Laws means any applicable law, proclamation, decree, ministerial decision, statute, statutory instrument, order, regulation, resolution, notice, legal precedent, by-law, directive, treaty or other instruments or requirements that have the force of law within Pakistan and are issued, declared, passed or given effect in any manner by any Competent Authority . 
 
 Nominee means such person, as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell, to Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Appendix A of the Agreement to Sell, setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer. 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Purchased Unit as a residential unit in accordance with applicable laws, including inter alia the by-laws of DHAI-R . 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit (exclusive of tax) including Component Materials, White Goods (as specified in Appendix C ), in the manner and in such instalments , as identified in the Payment Plan in Appendix A to the Agreement to Sell, as may be modified in terms hereof including under Clause 9.2 and any Adjusted Amount in terms of Clause 3.3 of the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed and finished house and plot as specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, including White Goods, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement . 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location, as shown in Appendix B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Other Purchased Unit (s) means any one or more of the finished houses in the Venture . 
 
 White Goods means those household appliances provided in the Purchased Unit (s) as specifi ed in Table A listed of Appendix C . 
 
 1.2. Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Agreement to: 
 
 An Article, Clause, attachment, or paragraph are reference to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of the Agreement or the relevant document comprising the Agreement; 
 
 Any headings in the Agreement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad, Pakistan; 
 
 Any reference to a Party shall, where the context permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement; 
 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any Purchased Unit by the Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of the Developer’s rights relating to the Purchased Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Purchased Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 2.1 The Developer confirms that it has the necessary rights and title to the Purchased Unit, to construct and to sell the Purchased Unit and that it has received approvals from Competent Authorities for the development and construction of the Purchased Unit. Further, the Developer agrees to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer , strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 PAYMENT 
 
 The construction, sale and transfer of the Purchased Unit by the Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date, as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Appendix A of the Agreement, along with any applicable Adjusted Amount; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all, electricity, water, or other utility and meter connection charges, as per applicable laws, as and when due with respect to the Purchased Unit ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable allotment/transfer charges, taxes, fees, stamp duties, levies or any other charges (if any) whatsoever for registration or transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer as per Clause 4 below; and 
 
 The Buyer’s formal written undertaking to abide by all Laws and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit, and to make all payments of duties, taxes, levies and charges whatsoever as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit or the Buyer’s ownership thereof or other rights therein. 
 
 The Buyer understands and agree that the Purchase Price does not include any costs associated with the transferring and recording of any rights in the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer, including the registration and stamping of the sale/purchase documentation or any other fee or charge (if any) as envisaged under Clause 3.1 (i ii ) which shall be payable separately by the Buyer. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit shall remain fixed under the Agreement except in the event of any unforeseeable events arising that are not in control of the Developer (hereinafter “ Unforeseeable Event ”) including but not limited to : (i) any increase in the prevailing market rates of White Goods and Component Material s including but not limited to those specified in Appendix C appended to this Agreement ; (ii) any change in the rates of the Component Material s , as notified by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, State Bank of Pakistan, vide the price indices (including, without limitation, as a result of fluctuation in the FOREX rates); (iii) any increase in the bill of quantities; (iv) any change in the P urchased Unit design and layouts, and/or (v) any change in the applicable taxes or levy of any additional tax with respect to White Goods and Component Material. Any change in the Purchase Price due to an Unforeseeable Event shall be referred to as the “ Adjusted Amount ”. The Adjusted Amount shall be calculated and adjusted in the Purchase Price from time to time, in such manner and at such time as communicated by the Developer. The Developer shall make reasonable effort that the Purchase Price remains unaffected and ensure that any adjustments to the Purchase Price are fair and reasonable .
